page.layout: One column of running text, printed page number at the top centre, catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes, no running head.

main_text.p: Tum scripsit ad omnes Orientales Patriar-chas Epistolam de cogenda Synodo Oecu-menica aduersus Nicolaum, Latinam Ec-clesiam multis appictis[?] criminibus calu-mniose infamans. Post cædem Bardæ nihil se profecisse cernens, persuadet Michaeli, ut coacta Synodo Nicolaum damnaret, a quo fuerat antea ipse damnatus. Sic colle-ctis suæ factionis Episcopis, substitutisque aliis, qui vicem Patriarcharum Orientis te-nerent, in Romanum Pontificem anathema-tis sententiam a se in Concilio latam notam Italis per Legatos suos facit, conatus etiam Ludouicum Imperatorem inducere, ut Ni-colaum a Sede deturbaret, promittens se proclamaturum illum Constantinopoli Im-peratorem. Cæso Michaele initio Imperij Basilij plena Synodo Photius eijcitur, & re-stituitur Ignatius. Sed post multos annos fraudibus mire concinnatis, reconciliatus Basilio, & vita functo Ignatio in Cathedram restitutus, Ignatianos diris vexationibus af-fligit, postea Pontificis literis, quarum ille contextum immutauerat[?], detrahendo, quæ in Ecclesiæ Romanæ auctoritatem; & Igna-tij laudem, vel in reprehensionem suiipsius[?] dicta essent, addendo multa in laudem pro-priam, & damnationem Synodorum con-tra ipsum celebratarum, ac deinceps omnia pro

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "appictis" (possibly a misprint for "appositis"), "immutauerat" (printed with u for v, read as immutaverat), "suiipsius" (doubled i as printed), and the mark after "auctoritatem" which is read as ";" but could be "/". Spelling u/v normalised as instructed; "ut" written for printed "vt", "Ludouicum", "Photius", "eijcitur" and "Cæso" kept as printed. The page opens without an indent, so it is marked as a continuation. The printed catchword "pro" is at the lower right.
